//: Telemetry sink. Events go to RaftLabs' own admin API — no third-party processor and no credential on developer machines, so there is nothing here to leak. While `endpoint` is empty, events spool locally and nothing leaves the machine. `file_issues` stays false for the Phase 1 observe-only rollout; flip it to true for Phase 2 once dedup has been proven against a scratch repo. Env overrides for local testing: RAFTKIT_TELEMETRY_ENDPOINT, RAFTKIT_ISSUE_REPO, RAFTKIT_FILE_ISSUES.
